Two parallel listing-edit implementations exist for the same UC-51.5 function: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/account/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx (33KB inline 5-step wizard, Slovak strings, uses ./_mock EDIT_STEPS) and frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/realtor/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx (4KB, English strings, delegates to the shared components/realtor/ListingForm). Both call getMyListing/updateListing from lib/realtor-api. They diverge in language, UI structure and validation; one is almost certainly dead/legacy.
